_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/casting/test_cast_only_during.py. Each is a one-mana instant whose payload is a bare draw, so the tests measure the window and not the effect. t_cod_gambit is Illusionist's Gambit's first line (an opponent's declare blockers step), t_cod_delirium is Delirium's (an opponent's turn, any step), t_cod_beating is Savage Beating's (combat on your turn, written as a phase), and t_cod_free is the identical instant WITHOUT a window, kept live so every 'cannot be cast' assertion is measured against a card that can.

cards.name: Test Gambit Window
cards.oracle_text:
Cast this spell only during the declare blockers step on an opponent's turn.
Draw a card.

cards.name: Test Delirium Window
cards.oracle_text:
Cast this spell only during an opponent's turn.
Draw a card.

cards.name: Test Beating Window
cards.oracle_text:
Cast this spell only during combat on your turn.
Draw a card.
